mechanism: Leflunomide may increase ampicillin levels through potential inhibition of renal tubular secretion and competition for active transport mechanisms, while ampicillin may theoretically reduce enterohepatic recirculation of leflunomide's active metabolite.
action: Monitor for ampicillin efficacy and toxicity; consider alternative antibiotics if possible, particularly in renal impairment; maintain adequate hydration to support renal clearance.
